name: GeoFS Flight Path Vector
notes: v1.0.1 by GGamerGGuy. Adds a Cesium billboard entity (geofs.api.viewer.entities.add) ahead of the aircraft, image hotlinked from tylerbmusic.github.io. Read-only on the aircraft. Its keydown handler checks event.key === 'l' with no modifier check, so Alt+L would also toggle it if race.js did not swallow the event first (race.js listens on window in the capture phase and calls stopImmediatePropagation). The All-in-one copy is a minified variant that uses Insert instead of L.

name: GeoFS Sky Dolly
notes: v0.4 by GGamerGGuy. Formation-mode recording/playback, logbook and a camera animator, all driven from a GUI panel (no keybinds). Reads geofs.aircraft.instance.llaLocation; playback moves its own ghost models (setPositionOrientationAndScale) and calls geofs.camera.set() — it does not write the player aircraft. Largest of the six (~77 KB).

name: GeoFS Camera Cycling

hotkeys.action: start/stop cycling camera modes every 30 s (random order, skips modes 2-5)

notes: v1.6. Calls geofs.camera.set() on a 30 s timer while cycling; stops on aircraft change. The All-in-one README says it is disabled there because W clashed with the flightradar addon. The handler refuses Ctrl/Alt/Meta, so it never collides with an Alt+ binding.

name: GeoFS Information Display

hotkeys.action: hide/show the info bar (userscript.js only; userscript-no-hide.js has no key)

notes: v2.4 by krunchiekrunch. Bottom-right text bar: KIAS, Mach, GS, ALT, AGL, HDG, V/S (userscript-no-hide.js v2.5 adds throttle %). Read-only. The All-in-one copy is an extended minified variant (adds THR, AOA, glideslope, G, fuel).

name: GeoFS Cockpit Volume
notes: v1.0 by geofspilot. Halves geofs.preferences.volume while in a cockpit camera on aircraft without dedicated cockpit sounds and restores it on leaving. Writes a preference, not physics; would also scale race.js WebAudio only if race.js ever reads geofs.preferences.volume (it does not today).

name: GeoFS GPWS Callouts
notes: v1.4 by GGamerGGuy (some sounds from Bruh000-sad). Altitude/sink-rate/terrain callouts; sound files hotlinked from tylerbmusic.github.io. window.soundsToggleKey defaults to "none" (no key bound) — set it in the console to add one. Low-level canyon racing will trigger TERRAIN/SINK RATE constantly. The All-in-one loads the geofs-pilot/geofs-gpws-modified fork (b9d0c5582996ca3829f00789a9ad18ea9cd95dec, v1.2.1) instead.
